title: This Was So Disappointing
text:
So this was supposed to be the First Ten Years..... uh huh..... riiiight....
If you haven't opened your box and don't want to see what is inside I suggest you don't read the rest of what i am going to write and don't look at the picture i posted.
4 things....
Whiplash vs. Iron Man
2 Pint Size Heroes
1 Pez Dispenser

ummmm, yup.... Whiplash... I mean okay fine could you get some money for that.... suuuure.... but if we are celebrating the First Ten Years that's all they could come up with.... that's sad.... there is so much more they could have done and there is much more iconic things you could have done...

So $30 for this, I am so not happy.... I did have a giggle because it does say 4-7 per box and OF COURSE this one has only 4.... the one box everyone was probably overly excited about.... EPIC FAIL!!!!!!!!!!!

You gave us a big Funko Pop for one of the WORST MARVEL MOVIES.... clap clap clap.... unsubscribe.
label: negative
